cs.t: The POs are fun to play with, but from experience I would much rather recommend getting a used mk1 Novation Circuit. For $150 - $200 you have a four track drum machine plus two tracks of a great synth engine, with a built in mixer and simple effects, midi in if you want to use a keyboard, and the thing is still compact and battery powered.
